Ticketed concert performance
December 14, 2025

A Rose In Winter 

A celebration of Christmas in song and story.

The Choir of All Saints Cathedral
Directed by Paul Halley

Grammy Award-winner Paul Halley directs The Choir of All Saints Cathedral in a concert performance celebrating this joyous season. A program of choral music and readings from an impressive array of composers and authors will inspire the soul and warm the heart. Members of the choir will act as narrators, reading the stories and poems that alternate with the choral offerings in the program.

A Rose in Winter, now in its fourth year with the Cathedral Choir, has become a Christmas tradition for audiences in Nova Scotia. The Halifax concert sells out weeks in advance of the concert date, so the purchase of tickets as early as possible is advised. The Halifax concert takes place in the beautiful and historic Cathedral Church of All Saints on Cathedral Lane. Please note that there is only one performance of this beautiful concert this year. (There will be no concert in Lunenburg this year.)

 

Sunday, 14 December 2025, 4:00 PM
The Cathedral Church of All Saints
1330 Cathedral Lane, Halifax, NS
 

For tickets and information, go to:

A_Rose_In_Winter_2025.eventbrite.ca

 

 

Benefit concert performance
September 21, 2025 

Triptych

the unique trio of piano, pipe organ, and harpsichord
original compositions played by Paul Halley
with Nick Halley and Gabriel O'Brien

'Nick & Friends' Benefit Concert for Capella Regalis

Five-time Grammy Award-winning keyboardist and composer, Paul Halley, will lead a unique ensemble of three keyboard instruments: piano, pipe organ, and harpsichord. Paul Halley will be joined by his son, Nick Halley, and Capella Regalis alumnus, Gabriel O’Brien. Halley's multi-layered and multi-faceted arrangements present an astonishing repertoire for a rarely heard ensemble. With melodies that evoke images from island shores to the steppes of Russia, with rhythms that derive from Renaissance dance to contemporary jazz, Halley delivers music with an enormous range of expression. 

The compositions featured in this concert were created for the landmark 1999 recording "Triptych" featuring Paul Halley on piano, pipe organ, and harpsichord. Check-out this recording at this page on our website: Triptych | Pelagos Music

Sunday, September 21, 2025
Food at five and concert at 5:30 pm
The Cathedral Church of All Saints, Halifax, NS

Paul Halley is donating his time and talent on this occasion to this worthy organization.

Sheet music for the works presented in this 'Triptych' concert are available on these web pages at Pelagosmusic.
